theme_notes: Taglines draw from Ukraine launching hundreds of drones into Russia (Kyiv's largest aerial assault of the war), Jared Kushner's surprise meeting with Hamas leadership in Egypt to revive the stalled Gaza ceasefire, Hurricane Lala skirting Hawaii as a tropical storm, and Italy's chaotic week — police recovered three stolen paintings near Parma, then Sicily promptly lost four more masterpieces.
